content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by AIIMS Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bhubaneswar has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Project Research Scientist-I(Non-Medical), Project Nurse-III, and Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for these positions?
faq.answer: The last date for the walk-in interview is 23 September 2026. There is no separate application deadline mentioned.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Project Research Scientist-I?
faq.answer: For Project Research Scientist-I, a Post Graduate Degree in Life Sciences/Pharmacology/Public Health/Nursing is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Project Nurse III?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Project Nurse III is 30 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The salary offered for Project Technical Support-III is Rs. 28,000/-+HRA as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar, Odisha - 751019.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on a Walk-In-Interview.
